Halil.diyalog.Introduction: Welcome! I'm Halil. I run the village shop.#$b#Not many people come up here from the valley. Glad to see you.$h
Halil.diyalog.Mon: The shelves are always empty on Monday morning. The village clears me out over the weekend.
Halil.diyalog.Tue: Kerem's cheese is very good this year. It's gone as soon as I put it out.$h
Halil.diyalog.Wed: My father hung that shutter on the shop. Thirty years, same squeak every morning.
Halil.diyalog.Thu: At noon I step out to the square and sit by the well. The shop can mind itself for five minutes.
Halil.diyalog.Fri: Elif came asking for candy again. Don't tell Granny Nazife, I gave her one.$h
Halil.diyalog.Sat: Saturdays get crowded. Crowded for here, I mean... six people.$h
Halil.diyalog.Sun: I don't really open on Sundays. I can't stay away from the door either.
Halil.hediye.bayilir: How did you know? That's exactly my taste!
Halil.hediye.sevmez: Hmm. I wouldn't even shelve this.
Halil.hediye.nefret: Why would you bring me this?
Halil.hediye.notr: Thank you for thinking of me.
Nazife.diyalog.Introduction: Oh, a new face! Come, dear, come. I'm Nazife. Everyone calls me Granny, so you may too.$h
Nazife.diyalog.Mon: My late husband and I built this house together. He drove in every beam himself.
Nazife.diyalog.Tue: Have you seen Elif? That child never stays in one place.#$b#Her parents work in the city. I look after her.
Nazife.diyalog.Wed: I walk down to the well in the mornings. As far as my knees allow.$s
Nazife.diyalog.Thu: There used to be twenty households in this village. Now you can count us on one hand.$s
Nazife.diyalog.Fri: Zeynep mended my balcony railing. She took no money, only a plate of pastry.$h
Nazife.diyalog.Sat: Look at my flowers. The ones by the window bloomed early this year.$h
Nazife.diyalog.Sun: I roll out dough on Sundays. You can smell it all the way to the square.
Nazife.hediye.bayilir: Oh, how lovely! You've made me very happy, dear.
Nazife.hediye.sevmez: What would I do with this, child...
Kerem.diyalog.Introduction: Hey! I'm Kerem. The red barn is mine.#$b#You're the one who took over the farm in the valley, right? News travels up here too.$h
Kerem.diyalog.Mon: I get up before the cows do. They don't appreciate it.
Kerem.diyalog.Tue: This is good soil. My grandfather planted here, and my father after him.
Kerem.diyalog.Wed: In the afternoon I walk to the east end of the road. You can see the whole plain from there.
Kerem.diyalog.Thu: Granny Nazife taught me to make cheese. Don't tell anyone, she still hasn't given me half the recipe.$h
Kerem.diyalog.Fri: How's your farm going? If you get stuck on something, ask. I'll tell you what I know.
Kerem.diyalog.Sat: Saturday evenings we sit in the square. Halil tells stories, and it's always the same story.$h
Kerem.diyalog.Sun: Animals don't take Sundays off. I was up early today too.
Kerem.hediye.bayilir: Whoa! I love this, how did you know?
Kerem.hediye.nefret: Even the animals wouldn't eat this.
Zeynep.diyalog.Introduction: ...Hello. Zeynep. I'm a carpenter.#$b#People bring me things when they break. You can too.
Zeynep.diyalog.Mon: I built this house myself. It took two summers.
Zeynep.diyalog.Tue: Good wood tells you what it is. Knock on it and it sounds full.
Zeynep.diyalog.Wed: I redid the roof on the well last month. The old one had rotted.
Zeynep.diyalog.Thu: I don't care for crowds. That's why I stayed here.
Zeynep.diyalog.Fri: I'm carving a wooden horse for Elif. It isn't finished, so don't tell her.$h
Zeynep.diyalog.Sat: Halil's shutter squeaks. I offer to oil it and he says it's his father's sound.
Zeynep.diyalog.Sun: I don't work on Sundays. My hands won't stay idle, though.
Zeynep.hediye.bayilir: This is... exactly what I was looking for. Thank you.$h
Zeynep.hediye.sevmez: I don't know what I'd do with this.
Elif.diyalog.Introduction: Who are you? I'm Elif! I'm seven. Seven and a half.$h
Elif.diyalog.Mon: I named one of Kerem's cows. Her name is Cotton.$h
Elif.diyalog.Tue: You're not allowed to throw stones in the well. I never did. I did once.
Elif.diyalog.Wed: My granny walks really slow. I run really fast. Watch!
Elif.diyalog.Thu: Mister Halil gave me candy but it's a secret.
Elif.diyalog.Fri: Zeynep can make anything out of wood. I think she could make a ship.
Elif.diyalog.Sat: Do you have a horse on your farm? I never had a horse.$s
Elif.diyalog.Sun: No school today! Actually there's never school here.
Elif.hediye.bayilir: Yay! This is my favourite thing!
